Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- our coding agents keep overwriting each other
- version control for AI agents
- audit AI coding agent changes
- provenance and rollback for agent code
- multi-agent git alternative
- make GitHub a mirror instead of the only source of truth
- track why AI agents changed code

## Problem

A team is using multiple AI agents or AI-assisted developers and needs collision-safe history, provenance, rationale, integrity checks and rollback beyond ordinary Git-only workflow.

## Inputs

One buyer-authorized Git repository, accountable operator, and current agent/developer workflow context. Private repository access requires explicit authorization.

## Outputs

Git history import, private Lineage Control Room, stale-writer/CAS proof, human/agent history visibility, rationale/provenance workflow, semantic diff, fsck integrity baseline, ignore/sensitive-path policy, Git export/mirror proof, and closeout architecture packet.
